definitions.explanation: A group of stars forming a recognizable pattern in the night sky, traditionally named after mythological figures, animals, or objects.
One of the twelve astrological signs used in horoscopes, based on the position of the sun at the time of birth.

notes:
{星座|せいざ} has two main meanings: astronomical constellations and astrological zodiac signs.

COMMON CONSTELLATIONS:
- ⟦オリオン{座|ざ}→オリオン座：noentry⟧ (Orion)
- ⟦{北斗七星|ほくとしちせい}→北斗七星：29539_hokutoshichisei⟧ (Big Dipper)
- ⟦{南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}→南十字星：29540_minamijuujisei⟧ (Southern Cross)
- ⟦カシオペア{座|ざ}→カシオペア座：noentry⟧ (Cassiopeia)

- ⟦{牡羊座|おひつじざ}→牡羊座：29553_ohitsujiza⟧ (Aries)

- ⟦{蟹座|かにざ}→蟹座：29556_kaniza⟧ (Cancer)
- ⟦{獅子座|ししざ}→獅子座：29557_shishiza⟧ (Leo)
- ⟦{乙女座|おとめざ}→乙女座：29558_otomeza⟧ (Virgo)
- ⟦{天秤座|てんびんざ}→天秤座：29559_tenbinza⟧ (Libra)
- ⟦{蠍座|さそりざ}→蠍座：29560_sasoriza⟧ (Scorpio)
- ⟦{射手座|いてざ}→射手座：29561_iteza⟧ (Sagittarius)

- ⟦{水瓶座|みずがめざ}→水瓶座：29563_mizugameza⟧ (Aquarius)
- ⟦{魚座|うおざ}→魚座：29564_uoza⟧ (Pisces)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, asking about someone's zodiac sign ({星座|せいざ}) is a common conversation topic, often used as a light way to discuss personality traits.
